fusions.name: Lancing Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 16 poison damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Bursting Phial
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow carrying a phial that deals 12 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bitter Draught
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poisons from you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spent Venom
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs out, 6 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds.
